references.text: Describes the place for the ashes outside the camp where the remains of the sacrificial animals were cast, the same place mentioned in Leviticus 1:16 regarding the waste from the bird offering.
Refers to the priest who is to remove the ashes from the altar and carry them to a clean place outside the camp, connected to the ash location mentioned in Leviticus 1:16.
Describes a bird offering where the head is pinched off but not completely separated from the body, a parallel to the handling of the bird offering in Leviticus 1:16.
Refers to unclean things being cast on an unclean place outside the city, a similar principle to the bird offering's body being cast at the ash location.
Complementary steps in the handling of the ashes: placement by the altar (1:16) and removal out of the camp (6:4).
Parallel instruction to place the ashes beside the altar as part of ritual cleansing.
The same ritual location for slaughtering and post-sacrifice processing of the offering.
